poll_seconds.label: Poll interval
poll_seconds.description: Seconds between checks for the presentation state and the attached screen.

hide_without_display.label: Hide with no external screen
hide_without_display.description: Remove the widget from the bar when nothing is plugged in, instead of dimming it.

show_output_name.label: Show the output name
show_output_name.description: Print the external output (for example HDMI-A-1) next to the icon while idle.

right_click_action.label: Right click runs
right_click_action.description: Which present subcommand right click starts: mirror, desk, or on. Right clicking again while that mode is live stops it.

notify.label: Notify on start and stop
notify.description: Send a notification when a presentation begins or ends, including ones started from a keybind.

tooltip.hint_idle: Plug in a screen to present
tooltip.hint_ready: Left click: present window · Right click: mirror
tooltip.hint_live: Left click: stop · Right click: mirror

error.timeout: the present script did not answer
error.spawn: could not run the present script
